title: A 64-Rectangle Counterexample to Wegner's Conjecture and LP Gaps up to $5/2$
summary: Wegner conjectured that every finite family $\mathcal R$ of axis-parallel rectangles satisfies $τ(\mathcal R)\le 2ν(\mathcal R)-1$, where $ν$ is the packing number and $τ$ is the piercing number. Ajwani, Gajjala, Raman, and Ray recently disproved this by constructing a triangle-free counterexample on $2196\cdot 8^9$ rectangles and, using a computer-assisted package-and-port recursion, obtained a standard LP gap of $17891/8064$ for Maximum Independent Set of Rectangles.
